name: Deepnote
description_en:
Deepnote is a collaborative data workspace centered on notebooks that combine SQL, Python, text, inputs and visual results. Its current site also promotes data apps and agent workflows. This profile evaluates notebook execution, sharing, schedules and compute billing; marketing examples are not evidence of measured analytical accuracy or a production model deployment.

A team can connect a data source, run a SQL block into a named result and continue analysis in Python. Collaboration shares an execution environment, and publication or scheduling changes the operational context. Correct results, access boundaries and resource use still require explicit evaluation with representative data.
description_zh:
Deepnote 是以笔记本为中心、结合SQL、Python、文字、输入及可视结果的协作数据工作区，当前官网也介绍数据应用及Agent流程。本文研究笔记本执行、分享、调度与算力计费；营销示例不能证明实测分析准确性或生产模型部署。

团队可接数据源，将SQL块运行结果命名，再用Python继续分析。协作者共享执行环境，发布或调度又改变运行条件。需使用代表数据明确评估结果正确性、访问边界及资源用量。

review_notes: Original AI research draft based on the cited public official pages; no publication, price approval, independent review or product test is implied.
Earlier third-party feature and price claims are retained only in discovery provenance, not as current product evidence.

sections.title_en: A query preview is not the full analytical result
sections.title_zh: 查询预览不是完整分析结果
sections.en: Create a SQL block, choose its data source and name the result. By default, the complete query result becomes a Pandas DataFrame; Query preview mode instead returns the first100 rows and retains the source query for chaining. A proposed monthly-orders analysis should compare totals from the intended full query, not aggregate a100-row preview as if it were the population. DataFrame SQL uses DuckDB, while a warehouse integration uses that source’s SQL. Check dialect and memory use; no source was connected or query executed.
sections.zh: 创建SQL块、选数据源并命名结果。默认完整查询结果成为Pandas DataFrame；Query preview则返回前100行并保留源查询以继续组合。建议月度订单分析核对预期完整查询总额，不能把100行预览当总体汇总。DataFrame SQL用DuckDB，仓库集成则使用来源SQL，需核对方言及内存。本次未连接数据源或执行查询。

sections.title_en: Sharing code and executing it are different permissions
sections.title_zh: 分享代码与执行代码属于不同权限
sections.en: Project collaborators share the same execution environment, although two people cannot edit the same block simultaneously. Workspace projects are shared with members by default, respecting access levels. A link can allow reading without an account; execution requires signup and the corresponding access. AppUser hides project source, while View reads source but cannot execute; Execute adds running code without editing/hardware/sharing management. Confirm project and integration permissions together. A read-only page or encrypted stored credential does not establish that every runtime collaborator lacks access to that credential.
sections.zh: 项目协作者共享执行环境，但两人不能同时编辑同块。工作区项目默认按访问等级分享给成员；链接可允许匿名阅读，执行需注册及对应权限。AppUser不显示项目源码，View可读源码不可执行，Execute增加运行代码权但不含编辑／硬件／分享管理。需同时确认项目与集成权限；只读页面或凭据加密存储不能证明所有运行协作者都无法访问凭据。

sections.title_en: A successful schedule means no exception, not a validated result
sections.title_zh: 调度成功表示无异常，不表示结果已验证
sections.en: The scheduling guide defines a run as failed when an exception occurs and stops subsequent blocks; repeated failures pause the schedule automatically. Each run creates a snapshot. Add explicit data-quality assertions and inspect failed as well as successful runs. Scheduled OAuth integrations use the schedule creator’s tokens, which can expire or be revoked. The guide allows only one scheduled notebook per project and restricts hourly/custom schedules to Enterprise, despite broader homepage frequency wording. Evaluate unattended credentials and schedule recovery before relying on fresh dashboards.
sections.zh: 调度指南将发生异常定义为失败，停止后续块；反复失败会自动暂停，每次运行创建快照。需添加明确数据质量断言，并检查失败及成功运行。调度OAuth集成使用创建者token，可能过期或撤销。指南每项目只允许一个定时笔记本，并将小时／自定义调度限于Enterprise，范围窄于首页频率宣传。依赖最新仪表盘前应评估无人值守凭据及调度恢复。

sections.title_en: Notebook history does not cover the entire filesystem
sections.title_zh: 笔记本历史不覆盖完整文件系统
sections.en: Version history requires edit/admin access and can restore all notebooks together, first preserving a snapshot of the current state. Notebooks created since the selected version are removed and deleted ones can return. The page explicitly says the rest of the filesystem is no longer versioned. This is different from restoring datasets, installed dependencies, credentials, kernel state or external writes. Keep the needed independent artifacts and evaluate a disposable restore; no snapshot or recovery was performed.
sections.zh: 版本历史需edit／admin访问，可一起恢复全部笔记本，先保存当前状态快照；所选版本后新增笔记本会移除，已删除笔记本可恢复。页面明确其他文件系统不再版本化。这不同于恢复数据集、依赖、凭据、内核状态或外部写入。需保留所需独立材料并评估可丢弃恢复，本次未执行快照或恢复。

sections.title_en: Seats, machines and AI have different meters
sections.en: Pricing lists Free with up to3 editors and5 projects, Basic5GB RAM/2vCPU, and7-day revision history. The annual Team view shows$39 per editor/month and30-day history; Enterprise is quoted. Billing includes admins as paid seats, while viewers are not charged. Stronger machines are billed per running minute, with actual rates in the account’s Machines menu. AI has included monthly quota and paid overage. Confirm allowance scope, seat acceptance and annual refund conditions; a plan’s editor price is not a complete compute/AI budget.
sections.zh: 定价列Free最多3编辑者、5项目、Basic5GB内存／2vCPU及7天历史；Team年付视图每编辑者每月$39，历史30天，Enterprise询价。账单将admin计付费席位，viewer不计。更强机器按运行分钟收费，实际费率在账户Machines菜单；AI含月额度及付费超额。需确认额度范围、席位接受及年付退款条件，编辑者单价不是完整算力／AI预算。

sections.title_en: A machine-cost alert needs a separate stop decision
sections.title_zh: 机器费用提醒还需另行停止决策
sections.en: Machine alerts notify workspace admins after a calendar-month threshold. The guide allows up to30 minutes of usage-reporting lag, so charges may already exceed the alert. Disabling paid machines stops affected running projects and changes their next start to Basic; it can interrupt collaborators. AI overage has a separate configurable limit. Evaluate those controls and residual workflow effects independently rather than treating an email alert as an instantaneous universal cap. Nothing was paused or reconfigured here.
sections.zh: 机器提醒在自然月阈值后通知工作区管理员。指南允许最多30分钟用量报告延迟，账单可能已超提醒。禁用付费机器会停止相关运行项目，并在下次启动改为Basic，可能中断协作者；AI超额有单独配置限额。应分别评估控制及流程残留影响，不能将邮件提醒当即时通用硬上限。本次未暂停或改配置。
